highlights: Branch a conversation from any agent reply: right-click the message and select Branch from here.
Each agent has an Instructions page that shows its AGENTS.md file, and you can undo a change that the agent makes to its instructions.
The Marketplace is on openbot.run, with a page and a share link for each agent and skill.
Agents send fewer tokens with every provider, and idle browser tabs use much less memory.
In-app updates now install on slow Macs, such as Intel Macs.
